name: project-update-router
description: Routes project-update authoring (partner syncs, client status, architecture walkthroughs, strategic-pivot notes, retrospectives, investor updates) to the right artifact format — interactive microsite, long-form doc, Slidev, dashboard, hybrid PPTX — based on audience + distribution + content-shape + sensitivity. Scaffolds content from beads + git log + gstack learnings + project-local `.claude/project-update.yaml`. v0.3.0 is a singular plugin, installable anywhere, that reads each project's state contextually via five probes (identity, audiences, brand, deploy-infra, past-updates); reverts v0.2.0's Extension Consumer Protocol. Ships a Pattern Library with two observed patterns (partner-update-hub-microsite, self-retro-long-form) plus an advisory validator for `.claude/project-update.yaml`.
